content: Contentlayer is abandoned (maintainer down to ~1 day/month, sponsorship dried up, bug backlog growing). Modern replacements: Velite (actively maintained, Zod-schema-validated MD/MDX collections, used in production, has a Vite-compatible pipeline) and lighter community tools like Markdownlayer. For very small solo content sets, plain MDX + import.meta.glob or plain typed data files avoids taking on a content-pipeline dependency at all.
